minutes.summary: The School Committee met by Zoom for one item: amending its override figure after an earlier calculation error and newly certified new growth. Members debated how to word a letter to the Finance Committee and Select Board so the override tracks the town manager's budget number and aims at a level-services-minus-Esser school budget. The captions end mid-discussion, before any vote is heard.

A member said last week's voted figure was different and a calculation error prompted this meeting; the new number would bridge the town manager's number to level services minus Esser.
